description: Snap a type scale to a baseline grid. Pass `baseline` (px, default 8) and `sizes`: an array of pixel sizes, or "name:size" strings such as "h1:48" and "body:16". Optional: `bodySize` (default 16) and `rootPx` (default 16). Returns, per size, a line-height rounded to a whole number of baseline units (never under 1.1 times the size), margin-block start and end in baseline multiples, and CSS using calc(var(--baseline) * n). Preferred ratios fall as size rises (1.5 up to 18px, 1.35 up to 28px, 1.25 up to 40px, then 1.15); that curve and the margin pattern are conventions, with body leading in line with UXPin's 1.4 to 1.6 and vertical rhythm as a composition aid per Smashing's Typography Best Practices. Aligns line boxes and margins; it does not read font metrics.

baseline.description: Baseline unit in px (2 to 48, default 8).

rootPx.description: Root font size for rem output (default 16).

sizes.description: Font sizes in px, or "name:size" strings, up to 30.
